scope: Four fictional narrative test reports. No actual clients or financial claims.

fixtures.text: Fictional investment committee paper. The originally approved scope covered two workflows. The committee subsequently approved a revised scope covering three workflows. The total authorised investment was SGD 120000. Costs were stated on a nominal SGD basis for FY26. The original approval was dated 10 January 2026; the change approval was dated 4 April 2026. Planning assumed twenty cases per month. Change approval CH-01 was recorded. Intake was prioritised before reporting. No performance outcome is implied by this paper.

Fictional steering committee minutes. The reference for the decision was DEC-SYN-01. The decision was critical to the fictional rollout. It was raised on 1 March 2026 and required by 10 March 2026. The committee made the decision on 9 March 2026. The synthetic sponsor was accountable. The committee approved the fictional scope because the resource plan was agreed.

Fictional benefits realisation report. The benefit identifier is BEN-SYN-01. Realised value for the quarter was SGD 4000. The original target was SGD 5000. Reporting covers FY26 Q2 and amounts are denominated in SGD. The measure uses a realised cash basis. The underlying reference is synthetic finance ledger FIN-01. Finance recorded a mock validation approval. A separate forecast of SGD 2000 is not realised value.

Fictional programme commentary. The benefit identifier is BEN-SYN-02. A hoped-for forecast of SGD 9000 is explicitly not a realised result. Reporting covers FY26 Q3. No actual realised amount or original target is provided. Finance validation has not occurred. The record contains no source ledger, and no basis for a realised value is stated.
